SELECT m.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_event e WHERE e.meeting_id = m.id AND e.deleted = 0) AS event_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_registration r WHERE r.meeting_id = m.id AND r.deleted = 0) AS registration_count FROM t_meeting m WHERE m.deleted = 0
AND m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND m.status = #{status}
ORDER BY m.create_time DESC
